title: Split screen: Freestyle Objectives for 2–4 players
summary: The original's split Freestyle Objectives mode is now playable for 2–4 players: split layout, per-player compass and target tags, shared clock, and round-robin results.
details: Split Screen → Freestyle Objectives → course → objective launches a shared objective for all players; all share one clock and target set. Objectives go to the first player to touch them, combos count per player, and players rank by targets/combos collected then score. The run ends at the last target, the first player to complete the last combo, or time out; the leader and tied leaders win. Results show 'Congratulations, Player n!' or announce ties. Each player sees their own compass (per-player split layout) and target tags in their view. Sounds play from the nearest player's camera position, as the original picks the nearest listener. Restart Objective and Continue both work.

Verification: split-targets-start shows layout with 2 players each with compass and view of targets at course start (13 targets, time 2:00, p1 and p2 at 0). split-targets-results shows completion with both players' target counts (p1 7, p2 6) and a winning results dialog addressing Player 1 by name.
limitation: Split Duel, Lap Attack, and Practice race types are not yet built. Compass scale on split is not traced. Per-view audio levels are not measured. CPU riders are silent in the port.
caption: Results after completion: Player 1 wins with 7 targets vs Player 2's 6; split-screen results are not saved.
